DerivedColumn split((isNull(MRN) && (isNull(PART_A) || isNull(PART_B))),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit1@(leads, contacts)
ConditionalSplit2@toSFDC derive(OtherStreet = concatWS(' ',HOME_ADDR1,HOME_ADDR2),
		OtherPostalCode = concatWS('-',toString(HOME_ZIP),toString(HOME_ZIP4)),
		MailingStreet = concatWS(' ',MAIL_ADDR1,MAIL_ADDR2),
		MailingPostalCode = concatWS('-',toString(MAIL_ZIP),toString(MAIL_ZIP4)),
		PTC_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(PTC_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),PTC_DATE),
		PTC_EXPIRY_DT = coalesce(toString(toDate(PTC_EXPIRY_DT, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),PTC_EXPIRY_DT),
		OPPORTUNITY_CREATE = case(isNull(OPPORTUNITY_CREATE),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(OPPORTUNITY_CREATE)),OPPORTUNITY_CREATE)),
		DO_NOT_SOLICIT = case(isNull(DO_NOT_SOLICIT),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(DO_NOT_SOLICIT)),DO_NOT_SOLICIT)),
		NOTINTERESTED = case(isNull(NOTINTERESTED),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(NOTINTERESTED)),NOTINTERESTED)),
		ISMEDICARE = case(isNull(ISMEDICARE),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(ISMEDICARE)),ISMEDICARE)),
		GENDER = case(upper(GENDER) == 'F', 'Female', upper(GENDER) == 'M', 'Male',  upper(GENDER) == 'U', 'Undeclared', GENDER),
		PREF_LANG = case(lower(PREF_LANG) == 'eng', 'English', lower(PREF_LANG) == 'spa', 'Spanish', PREF_LANG),
		PART_A_EFF_DT = coalesce(toString(toDate(PART_A_EFF_DT, 'yyyyMMdd')),PART_A_EFF_DT),
		PART_B_EFF_DT = coalesce(toString(toDate(PART_B_EFF_DT, 'yyyyMMdd')),PART_B_EFF_DT),
		PTE_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(PTE_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),PTE_DATE),
		PTE_EXPIRY_DT = coalesce(toString(toDate(PTE_EXPIRY_DT, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),PTE_EXPIRY_DT),
		CONTACT_OWNER = '0053h000001DkXxAAK',
		MAILINGCOUNTRYCODE = 'US',
		OTHERCOUNTRYCODE = 'US',
		CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),CMS_ENROLL_SUBMIT_DATE),
		CMS_FILE_DATE = coalesce(toString(toDate(CMS_FILE_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy')),CMS_FILE_DATE),
		MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE, 'MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm')),MEDNET_APP_SUBMIT_DATE),
		BIRTH_DT = coalesce(toString(toTimestamp(BIRTH_DT, 'yyyyMMdd')),BIRTH_DT),
		BADEMAIL = case(isNull(BADEMAIL),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(BADEMAIL)),BADEMAIL)),
		MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE = case(isNull(MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE)),MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE)),
		NAME_CHANGE = case(isNull(NAME_CHANGE),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(NAME_CHANGE)),NAME_CHANGE)),
		OK_TO_MAIL = iif(upper(OK_TO_MAIL)=='Y','yes', iif(upper(OK_TO_MAIL)=='N','no', OK_TO_MAIL)),
		OtherCountry = 'United States',
		OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS = case(isNull(OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS),'false',coalesce(toString(toBoolean(OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS)),OK_TO_EMAIL_FOR_SEMINARS))) ~> DerivedColumn
ConditionalSplit1@leads derive(Company = concat(LAST_NAME, ' HOUSEHOLD'),
		MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE = coalesce(toString(toBoolean(MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE)),(MAILING_ADDRESS_CHANGE)),
		NAME_CHANGE = coalesce(toString(toBoolean(NAME_CHANGE)),(NAME_CHANGE))) ~> DerivedColumn1
ConditionalSplit1@leads select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Notes__c = NOTES
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select3
ConditionalSplit1@contacts select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Notes__c = NOTES
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: false,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: false) ~> Select4
ConditionalSplit1@contacts derive(RecordTypeId = '0123h000000t1WJAAY',
		CALL_REASON = case( isNull(CALL_REASON),'KPWA Lead Load', CALL_REASON),
		MEMBER_ROLE = iif(isInteger(SUBSCRIBER_MRN),'Dependent',MEMBER_ROLE)) ~> DerivedColumn2
Select1, RecordTypeId join(1 == 1,
	joinType:'left',
	matchType:'exact',
	ignoreSpaces: false,
	broadcast: 'right')~> AddRecordTypeId
inbound derive(ADFId__c = uuid()) ~> DerivedColumn3
DerivedColumn3 split(isNull(FIRST_NAME)||isNull(LAST_NAME)||isNull(KP_MBR)||isNull(CONTACT_OWNER)||isNull(PROMO_ID)||((upper(OPPORTUNITY_CREATE)=='Y')&&isNull(ROLE))||(isNull(SUBSCRIBER_MRN)==false()&&isInteger(SUBSCRIBER_MRN)==false())|| isNull(PTT)==false()&&(lower(PTT)!='yes'&&lower(PTT)!='no')||lower(PTT)=='yes'&&(isNull(PTT_SCOPE)||isNull(PTT_SOURCE)),
	disjoint: false) ~> ConditionalSplit2@(toReject, toSFDC)
ConditionalSplit2@toReject derive(REJECT_REASON = concat('ADF:Required Field Contains NULL Or Invalid Value: ', iif(isNull(FIRST_NAME), 'FIRST_NAME ', ''), iif(isNull(LAST_NAME), 'LAST_NAME ', ''), iif(isNull(KP_MBR), 'KP_MBR ', ''), iif(isNull(CONTACT_OWNER), 'CONTACT_OWNER ', ''), iif(isNull(PROMO_ID), 'PROMO_ID ', ''),iif(isNull(ROLE)&&{OPPORTUNITY_CREATE}=='Y', 'ROLE is NULL with OPP = Y ', ''),iif((isNull(SUBSCRIBER_MRN)==false()&&isInteger(SUBSCRIBER_MRN)==false()), 'SUBSCRIBER_MRN is not integer', ''),iif(lower(PTT)=='yes'&&(isNull(PTT_SCOPE)||isNull(PTT_SOURCE)),'No PTT_SOURCE or PTT_SCOPE when PTT = yes',''),iif(isNull(PTT)==false()&&(lower(PTT)!='yes'&&lower(PTT)!='no'),'PTT MUST be null/yes/no',''))) ~> rejectReason
rejectReason select(mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		REJECT_REASON
	),
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true) ~> Select5
AddRecordTypeId sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:[('ib_kpma_new_contact_Lead.csv')],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertLead
Select2 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_new_contact_Contact.csv'],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> insertContact
Select3 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['new_contact_Lead_Notes.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> notesLead

	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['new_contact_Contact_Notes.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	mapColumn(
		ADFId__c,
		Notes__c
	),
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> notesContact
DerivedColumn3 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_new_contact_raw.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> CuratedInbound
Select5 sink(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	partitionFileNames:['ib_kpma_new_contact_source_reject.csv'],
	skipDuplicateMapInputs: true,
	skipDuplicateMapOutputs: true,
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> Reject
